Change a person's email, name or attributes. Your app's SDK may overwrite them the next time it sets
them: the newest write wins.

Usage:
  voidhash person edit [person] [flags]

Arguments:
  person  The person's email, distinct id (the id your app identifies them by) or id

Flags:
      --email <email>         Their new email
  -h, --help                  Show help for this command
      --json                  Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>           Their new name
      --project <project>     Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                              this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                 Print only ids, one per line
      --set <key=value>       An attribute to set, as key=value (numbers, true, false and null as
                              such) (can be repeated)
      --set-once <key=value>  An attribute to set only when they have none yet, as key=value (can be
                              repeated)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash person edit user-42 --email ada@example.com
  voidhash person edit ada@example.com --set plan=team --set seats=5 --set-once referrer=newsletter
